messages:
maya: quick q — when the generation API receives a prefill (prefix) that matches a cached KV entry, do we return the cached tokens with an explicit header, or only use cache to fast-forward internally? Trying to decide client behaviour for streaming + cache indicators.

ashwin: we currently fast-forward internally and stream from runtime; we do set a response header `x-prefill-cache-hit: 1` for full-prefix hits but not for partial hits. is that documented? not really.

samir: partial hits are tricky — we stitch from cache then continue generation. For partial hits header is `x-prefill-cache-partial: bytes=0-123` (WIP). we shouldn't surface raw byte ranges though. pinging @natalie for API contract decision.

natalie: +1 to keep headers simple. prefer `x-prefill-cache-status: miss|partial|hit`. less surface area for clients.

maya: ok that sounds good. does the header need to be present for streaming chunks? i.e., first response arrives streaming, then header is less visible.

ashwin: header present on initial response (non-streamed http headers). For SSE/stream we include an early event: `event: cache-status\ndata: hit` before token events.

samir: here's a suggested curl example for docs, can we standardize format? ```curl -i -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"...","prefill":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` look for `x-prefill-cache-status` or SSE `cache-status` event.

maya: SG. Also need to confirm backward compatibility: old clients expect `x-cache-hit` maybe. we should map legacy header for a release cycle.

natalie: add `x-cache-hit-legacy` for one release and log warnings. open PR to add shim + docs.

ashwin: PR #8932 created with headers + SSE event + unit tests. cc @maya @samir for review.

maya: reviewing today, small nits in tests. also add an integ test that toggles `Cache-Control: no-store`.

samir: for invalidation plan: invalidate prefix keys on model update + rolling version. we'll emit `x-prefill-cache-ttl` header with remaining seconds so clients can decide.

natalie: ttl header is fine. ensure we don't leak large numbers. cap at 7 days.

infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled: eng-platform canary 3h from now. watch /dash/prefix-cache for hit-rate.

deploy-bot: completed canary (3/3 hosts), no errors, rolling to prod.

maya: thanks. will update docs & announce in #docs after prod rollout.
